services.name: Tiki Yacht
services.desc: This 26 foot pontoon boat is the ultimate floating paradise. It has a barbecue, bar area, ample area for dance parties, and comfortable seating arrangements - all while comfortably achieving speeds of 35 km/h. Open up the cooler, fire up the tunes, and drop the anchor to take a swim with fifteen of your closest friends. Visit some of the many cliff-lined coves along the coast. Be the envy of everyone on

blurb: Guests rent various boats and personal watercraft to enjoy water sports, cruising, and sightseeing on Okanagan Lake. Options include jet skis, bowriders, a surfboat, and a pontoon yacht. Some boats include features like wakeboard towers, swim platforms, and onboard BBQ and bar.
